verdict.rationale: First-party docs name `@vercel/sandbox` as the official SDK for JavaScript and TypeScript and recommend the SDKs as the primary integration path. The SDK provides a programmatic interface to create sandboxes, run commands, and manage files. Specific SDK behaviors are documented, including `sandbox.extendTimeout()`, auto-snapshot on stop, blocking and detached commands, and log streaming. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond JS/TS (the docs say "SDKs" but name only one), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK's depth and quality.
